_note: Invented client replies that arrive after an invoice is sent. "arrives" is when in the demo: after the client pays (a credit becomes a refund) or while the invoice is unpaid (a credit becomes a corrected invoice). "expected" is the hand-checked answer used to score Claude's draft (npm run eval:replies).

replies.subject: Re: Lanternfish Leads: October 2026 invoice

Jordan
